предавать.gloss: to betray, to be unfaithful to

meanings.note: Break trust or allegiance. Prefix 'пред-' ('before, fore-') indicates anticipation or prior position (stem 'авать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to betray, to be unfaithful to', paired with 'предать'.

examples.trans: And you are betraying your family right now!
